mapper.select: select k.id, k.user_id as userId, u.username, u.role_code as roleCode, k.secret_hash as secretHash, k.status, k.total_quota as totalQuota, k.used_quota as usedQuota, k.expires_at as expiresAt, k.user_package_id as userPackageId, p.package_name as packageName, g.package_type as packageType, k.model_group_id as modelGroupId, g.group_code as groupCode, g.group_name as groupName, coalesce(w.balance, 0) as balance, u.package_restriction_enabled as packageRestrictionEnabled from api_keys k join users u on u.id = k.user_id and u.deleted = 0 left join wallets w on w.user_id = u.id left join user_model_packages p on p.id = k.user_package_id left join model_groups g on g.id = k.model_group_id where k.access_key = #{accessKey} and k.deleted = 0
mapper.update: update api_keys set used_quota = used_quota + #{amount}, updated_at = now() where id = #{apiKeyId}
